name: baseline
policy:
# Baseline example: deny-listed posture
# Anything not matched is allowed
apiVersion: cyberboar.dev/v1
kind: Policy
metadata:
  name: baseline
  description: Keep secrets and destructive infrastructure commands away from coding agents.
spec:
  defaults:
    posture: deny-listed
  files:
    deny:
      - "**/.env*"
      - "**/*.pem"
      - "~/.ssh/**"
      - "~/.aws/credentials"
    ask:
      - "**/terraform.tfstate"
    # A directory that contains a protected file is treated like that file
    # (grep -r KEY ., tar ~). deny is the default; ask or ignore loosen it.
    containing: deny
  commands:
    deny:
      - "terraform apply"
      - "kubectl delete"
      - "curl | sh"
    ask:
      - "git push"
    denyInterpreters: true
  mcp:
    allow:
      - "github"
      - "internal-docs/search"
  audit:
    sink: "https://cyberboar.internal/api/v1/events"
